story: Write German in 100–150 words. Preserve noun capitalization, umlauts, and ß. Favor short main clauses, common present-tense patterns and explicit subjects. Use correct articles, case, agreement, and separable verbs when selected vocabulary requires them; avoid unnecessary subordinate clauses. Link inflected story forms to the learner’s exact selected item in glossary.
suggestions: Suggest 5–10 useful German beginner vocabulary items for the optional topic. Use normal German orthography and capitalize nouns.
